difficulty_rationale: Complex multi-subsystem feature: content addressing, deduplication, immutability enforcement, versioning, canonical serialisation, three indexing mechanisms, atomic activation, per-tenant scoping, audit trail, and REST API surface.
integration_surface_rationale: Touches event store (REPO-06), instance model (REPO-05), definition engine (REPO-08, REPO-09), service task system (REPO-07), and audit subsystem (REPO-10). Requires coordination across 4+ existing modules.
